en: A black-and-white image of a large, traditional, two-story wooden house surrounded by a picket fence and situated in a rural, forested area. There is a flagpole flying the Norwegian flag in front of the house. Some people are seated on the porch, and the environment is lush with trees and hills in the background. The printed text at the bottom identifies the place as 'Espa. Raavangen Pensjonat.'
